acquisition_method.evidence: The Q Exactive Hybrid Quadrupole-OrbitrapTM Mass Spectrometer was run in data-dependent mode with survey scans acquired at a resolution of 75,000 at m/z 200.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Beads were washed with 50 mm AMBIC (twice) before addition of 4 μl 100 mm iodoacetamide in 50 mm AMBIC at room temperature for 30 min (in the dark) before washing with 50 mm AMBIC (twice).

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Beads were washed with 50 mm AMBIC (twice) before addition of 4 μl 100 mm iodoacetamide in 50 mm AMBIC at room temperature for 30 min (in the dark) before washing with 50 mm AMBIC (twice).

cleavage_agent.evidence: 1.6 μg of trypsin (modified sequencing grade, Promega) dissolved in 50 mm AMBIC was added to the beads and samples were digested overnight at 37 °C with shaking at 1000 rpm.
